kld.text: Baral, a Consulate officer who is secretly a mage, was tasked with prosecuting Chandra for fire magic and kept hunting the renegades, stabbing Kiran and torching Bunarat.
He tried to execute Chandra at Ghirapur, but her spark ignited and she planeswalked to Regatha, and his face was burned.
In a Dhund cell, he taunted Pia with the claim that he had killed her daughter, until she knocked off his mask and answered that his scars were the work of her child.
When Chandra came back, he trapped her and her friends in a sealed cell, though Baan eventually charged him with murder and attempted murder and imprisoned him in the Dhund.
